title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Master's (CGRS-M)
description: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Master's program provides financial support to high-calibre scholars engaged in an eligible master's or, in some cases, doctoral program in Canada. Part of the harmonized Canada Research Training Awards Suite (CRTAS).
official_source: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
eligibility: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, and international students
Enrolled or intending to enroll in a full-time eligible master's program at a Canadian institution
Meet the specific agency mandate (CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC)
Have not exceeded lifetime maximum of tri-agency support
eligibility_summary: Open to domestic and international students in full-time master's programs at Canadian institutions, subject to agency-specific research mandates.
benefits: Can be held at any eligible Canadian university
requirements: Application through CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC portal
Research proposal aligned with agency mandate
application_method: Apply directly to CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC online portal
selection_notes: Merit-based; evaluated by agency-specific peer review committees.
best_fit: High-calibre master's students seeking research funding across all disciplines.
notes: Replaces the former CGS-M program under the harmonized CRTAS suite. International students are eligible through all three agencies.

title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral (CGRS-D)
description: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral program recognizes and supports the next generation of outstanding innovators and researchers. Part of the harmonized Canada Research Training Awards Suite (CRTAS).
official_source: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
eligibility: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, and international students
Enrolled or intending to enroll in a full-time eligible doctoral program at a Canadian institution
Meet the specific agency mandate (CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC)
Have not previously received a doctoral-level scholarship from CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC
Can apply a maximum of three times
eligibility_summary: Open to domestic and international doctoral students at Canadian institutions, with agency-specific research mandate alignment.
benefits: Eligible for affiliated fellowships and supplements
requirements: Application through CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC portal
Research proposal aligned with agency mandate
application_method: Apply directly to CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC online portal
selection_notes: Merit-based; evaluated by agency-specific peer review committees. Automatically considered for affiliated fellowships at some institutions.
best_fit: Outstanding doctoral students pursuing research careers across all disciplines.
notes: Replaces the former CGSD program under the harmonized CRTAS suite. Distinct from the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship.

title: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS)
description: The Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS) is a merit-based scholarship program jointly funded by the Province of Ontario and Ontario universities. It supports outstanding graduate students in all disciplines of academic study.
application_period: University-specific internal deadlines; provincial competition annually
official_source: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto / Ontario Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security
eligibility: Canadian citizens, Permanent Residents, Protected Persons
International students with a valid study permit by the university deadline
Enrolled or intending to enroll full-time in an eligible master's or doctoral program at an Ontario university
Minimum A- average in last two academic years
Must not have exceeded lifetime maximum of government-funded student awards
eligibility_summary: Open to domestic and international graduate students at participating Ontario universities with strong academic records.
coverage: Living stipend: up to $15,000 per year
requirements: Apply through the participating Ontario university
Research proposal or statement of intent
application_method: Submit application to the Ontario university where you plan to hold the award
selection_notes: University-specific internal deadlines apply. Applications are first adjudicated at the university level, then forwarded to a centralized provincial competition.
best_fit: Graduate students with strong academic records seeking merit-based funding at Ontario universities.
notes: International students are eligible for a set number of awards at each university. Cannot be combined with certain other government awards beyond lifetime maximums.
_cycle: University-specific internal deadlines; provincial competition annually

title: Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship (AGES)
description: The Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship recognizes outstanding academic achievement of students pursuing graduate studies in Alberta. Funded by the Government of Alberta through the Alberta Heritage Scholarship Fund.
official_source: Alberta Student Aid / University of Alberta
eligibility: Canadian citizens, Permanent Residents, Protected Persons
International students with a valid study permit
Must be living in Alberta while studying at an Alberta post-secondary institution
Enrolled full-time in a thesis-based or course-based master's or doctoral program
Demonstrate academic excellence (typically GPA 3.3+)
eligibility_summary: Open to domestic and international graduate students enrolled at Alberta institutions who demonstrate outstanding academic achievement.
requirements: Nomination by home faculty/department (students cannot apply directly in most cases)
documents: Research proposal or explanation of program goals
application_method: Nominated by Alberta post-secondary institution faculty
Some institutions allow direct application via graduate awards portal
selection_notes: Institutions select recipients based on minimum eligibility criteria and any additional institution-specific criteria.
best_fit: Outstanding graduate students pursuing thesis-based or course-based studies at Alberta universities.
notes: A student may receive only one AGES per year. Not renewable. International students are eligible but must hold a valid study permit and be living in Alberta.

title: Quebec Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE)
description: The Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE) is funded by the Fonds de recherche du Québec (FRQ) and the Quebec Ministry of Higher Education. It aims to attract top foreign researchers and students to Quebec universities.
duration: Variable by level (Master's: up to 2 years; Doctoral: up to 4 years; Postdoc: 1 year; Short-term: up to 4 months)
application_period: University preselection: October 2025; FRQ final submission: December 2, 2025
eligibility: International students (not Canadian citizens or permanent residents)
Enrolled or intending to enroll at a Quebec university or CCTT network
Master's: no more than 3 full-time terms completed by May 1 following deadline
Doctoral: within first 9 full-time terms by May 1 following deadline
Postdoctoral: PhD obtained within 2 years before competition deadline
Short-term research: PhD obtained within 5 years before deadline
Preselected by a Quebec university, CCTT network, or China Scholarship Council
eligibility_summary: International students in research master's, PhD, postdoctoral, or short-term research programs at Quebec institutions, preselected by their host university.
benefits: Doctoral: CAD 25,000/year for first 9 sessions, then CAD 12,000/year for remaining sessions
Short-term research: CAD 3,000/month for up to 4 months
Tuition exemption from higher international tuition fees
coverage: Research stipend: CAD 20,000–35,000 per year depending on level
Tuition exemption for international differential fees
application_method: Step 1: Get preselected by Quebec host university or CCTT network
Step 2: Complete application on FRQnet portal by December 2, 2025
selection_notes: Two-stage process: university/CCTT preselection, then FRQ evaluation by multidisciplinary committees based on academic excellence and research potential.
best_fit: Outstanding international graduate students and researchers pursuing studies at Quebec universities.
notes: Cannot be combined with Canadian federal or Quebec government scholarships, but can be combined with private or home-country funding. Must reside in Quebec during funded studies.
_cycle: University preselection: October 2025; FRQ final submission: December 2, 2025

title: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA)
description: The Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program is a federal research talent investment program in the Canada Research Training Awards Suite (CRTAS), jointly administered by CIHR, NSERC, and SSHRC. It replaces the former Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships and agency-specific postdoctoral fellowships.
deadline_display: CIHR: September 16, 2026; NSERC: October 17, 2026; SSHRC: September 10, 2026
official_source: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
eligibility: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, and international applicants
Hold (or expect to hold) a doctorate or health professional degree before award start date
Not hold or be on leave from a tenure-track or tenured faculty position
Have completed all degree requirements no more than three years before September 1, 2026
Cannot have previously received a tri-agency postdoctoral award
Cannot hold a CPRA concurrently with another tri-agency research training award
Apply to only one agency per year (CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC)
eligibility_summary: Outstanding postdoctoral researchers of all nationalities who have completed their PhD within the last three years and are not in tenured faculty positions.
requirements: Apply to the agency aligned with research subject (CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC)
Research proposal significantly distinct from doctoral thesis
application_method: Apply directly to CIHR ResearchNET, NSERC Online System, or SSHRC Application Portal
selection_notes: Evaluated based on research proposal quality, significance of contributions, and suitability of proposed research environment. Some awards reserved for Black postdoctoral researchers who self-identify.
best_fit: Top-tier postdoctoral researchers seeking advanced research training in Canada.
notes: Replaces the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships and former CIHR/NSERC/SSHRC postdoctoral fellowships. Maximum three lifetime applications permitted.

title: Canada-ASEAN Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development (SEED-2)
description: The Canada-ASEAN Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development (SEED-2) program offers short-term study or research opportunities in Canada for students from ASEAN member states and, under SEED-2, Pacific Island Countries and Mongolia. Funded by Global Affairs Canada under Canada's Indo-Pacific Strategy.
application_period: Applications open January 2026; institutional deadline March 24, 2026
eligibility: Citizens of ASEAN member states (Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam) or SEED-2 eligible Pacific Island Countries and Mongolia
Enrolled full-time at a post-secondary institution in home country
Continue paying tuition to home institution during exchange
Undergraduate/college: valid student exchange agreement between home and Canadian institutions
Graduate: supervisor invitation letter from Canadian host institution
No Canadian citizenship or permanent residency
Not already studying in Canada
Must not have previously received a SEED scholarship
eligibility_summary: Full-time students from eligible ASEAN/Pacific/Mongolia institutions for short-term study or research exchanges at Canadian designated learning institutions.
benefits: Host institution receives CAD 500 per scholar
coverage: Tuition waived by Canadian host institution
requirements: Letter of intent (maximum 1 page) aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals
Letter of support from home institution
documents: Letter of support from home university
application_method: Students cannot apply directly. Canadian host institution's international office submits application via MyEduCanada portal.
selection_notes: Global Affairs Canada reviews applications based on alignment with Sustainable Development Goals, research merit, and institutional partnerships.
best_fit: Students from eligible Indo-Pacific countries seeking short-term academic or research exchanges at Canadian universities.
notes: Non-deferrable and non-renewable. Students must return to home institution after exchange. Tuition is waived by the Canadian host institution.
_cycle: Applications open January 2026; institutional deadline March 24, 2026

title: Schulich Leader Scholarships
description: Schulich Leader Scholarships are Canada's most coveted undergraduate STEM scholarships. One hundred scholarships are awarded annually to entrepreneurial-minded high school graduates enrolling in STEM programs at 20 partner universities across Canada.
application_period: Nomination deadline: January 28, 2026; Application deadline: February 18, 2026
eligibility: Graduating high school or cégep in Canada in the 2026/2027 academic year
Canadian citizen
Plan to enroll in an eligible STEM program at a partner university
Entrepreneurial-minded (exhibiting leadership, charisma, and creativity)
Strong consideration given to students with financial need
Intend to pursue a career in Technology, Engineering, Entrepreneurship and business enterprise, or Applied scientific research
eligibility_summary: Canadian citizens graduating from Canadian high schools or CEGEPs who plan to study STEM at one of 20 partner universities.
requirements: Nomination by high school guidance counsellor (one per school per year, or four per CEGEP)
Academic achievement implied by university admission
documents: List of top three achievements (50 words each)
application_method: Step 1: Get nominated by high school guidance counsellor by January 28, 2026
Step 2: Submit online scholarship application by February 18, 2026
selection_notes: Highly competitive; evaluated on academic excellence, leadership, entrepreneurial spirit, and financial need.
best_fit: Outstanding Canadian high school graduates with leadership and entrepreneurial potential in STEM fields.
notes: Not considering students who focus on activism
_cycle: Nomination deadline: January 28, 2026; Application deadline: February 18, 2026

title: UCAS Scholarship for International Students 2026
degree: Master's, Doctoral, Senior Visiting Student, Regular Visiting Student, Joint Program
duration: Master/Doctoral: up to 36 months; Visiting students: 6-24 months
official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
eligibility_summary: Not hold Chinese citizenship, valid foreign passport, friendly to China, abiding by Chinese laws and UCAS rules. Proficient in English or Chinese. PhD applicants born after Jan 1, 1991; Master's applicants born after Jan 1, 1996; Senior visiting born after Jan 1, 1981; Regular visiting born after Jan 1, 1986; Joint program applicants no age limit. Must meet UCAS international student admission criteria. Must not take up other assignments during scholarship period. Currently enrolled students in China are ineligible for degree programs at the same level.

title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program) 2026
duration: Master: up to 36 months; PhD: up to 36 months (with possible extension)
official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
eligibility_summary: Not hold Chinese citizenship, valid foreign passport, friendly to China, abiding by Chinese laws and UCAS rules. Proficient in English or Chinese. Master's applicants born after Jan 1, 1996; PhD applicants born after Jan 1, 1991. Must meet UCAS/USTC admission criteria. Must not take up other assignments during scholarship period. Must not currently be pursuing a degree at any university/institution in China. NOT allowed to apply to both USTC and UCAS simultaneously.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship for Advanced Graduate Program at Peking University (CSC Type B)
eligibility_summary: Must meet Peking University admission requirements for international students. Must have successfully submitted application for 2026 full-time self-funded graduate programs. Must not have received other Chinese government or PKU scholarships (except one-time non-renewable merit awards). Must not be a joint training program candidate. Single CSC application allowed (one major only).

title: Tsinghua University Institutional Scholarship (Tsinghua University Scholarship)
duration: Up to 4 years (duration of undergraduate program)
eligibility_summary: International undergraduate applicants to Tsinghua University. No separate scholarship application required; selection based on admission materials (GPA, language scores, recommendations, study plan). Must also meet general Tsinghua admission requirements.
_cycle: 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 (application opens Sep 30, 2025; two rounds with deadlines Nov 28, 2025 and Feb 28, 2026)

title: Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program (AFLSP) 2026
eligibility_summary: Must be non-Chinese citizens from Asia (citizens of Asian countries). Must meet Tsinghua University admission requirements for international master's students. Must demonstrate academic excellence, leadership potential, integrity, good English proficiency and presentation skills. Must not be offered other scholarships for study at Tsinghua. Must be able to attend mandatory enrichment programs at Beijing campus (not open to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School applicants).

title: Atomic Energy Scholarship Program of China 2026
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries other than PRC committed to the nuclear industry for societal benefit, in good health. Holders of Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant majors (nuclear engineering, nuclear technology, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering, physics) with strong scientific research capability. Proficiency in English. Master's applicants under 35 years old; PhD applicants under 40 years old. Preference given to those with work experience in nuclear or related fields.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Chinese University Program) at Fudan University 2026
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-2 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system and indicate intention for CSC scholarship consideration. Must secure pre-admission from Fudan.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Youth of Excellence Scheme) at Fudan University 2026
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-2 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Open to youth of excellence applicants. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system. Must secure pre-admission from Fudan.

title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at Fudan University 2026
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-2 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system and indicate intention for Shanghai Government Scholarship consideration.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Dhaka) 2025/2026
degree: Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral, One-Year Chinese Language Program
duration: Duration of the degree program or one year for language program
eligibility_summary: Bangladeshi students who are outstanding and wish to pursue degree programs or Chinese language program in Chinese universities. Must be in good health and meet university admission requirements.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Jakarta) 2026/2027
duration: Undergraduate: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
eligibility_summary: Indonesian citizens (non-PRC), in good mental and physical health, not Chinese citizens. China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program. Must meet admission requirements of target universities. Applicants for English-taught programs must provide IELTS/TOEFL scores.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Nassau) 2026/2027
degree: Undergraduate, Master's, Doctoral, Advanced General Studies, Advanced Higher Studies
duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens, in good health both mentally and physically. Applied through Chinese Embassy in Bahamas (Bahamas Program Category A, Agency Number 0441). Must submit CSCA Score Report for bachelor's degree applicants intending September 2026 enrollment. Pre-admission documents required from target universities.

title: Czech Government Scholarship – Developing Countries for AY 2027/28
duration: Standard period of study (typically 2 years for Master's, 3-4 years for Doctoral)
eligibility_summary: Citizens of eligible developing countries including Bangladesh, Belarus (democratic opposition), Bosnia and Herzegovina, Cambodia, Ethiopia, Gabon, Georgia, Guatemala, Honduras, Mauritania, Palestine, Ukraine, Zambia and others. Must be admitted to selected Master's or Doctoral study programmes at Czech public universities.

title: Václav Havel Bursary
eligibility_summary: International students admitted to Charles University whose studies are hindered or prevented by repression under totalitarian, authoritarian, or other non-democratic regimes anywhere in the world. Students from countries where human rights and freedoms are violated and discriminatory measures restrict access to education.

title: Visegrad Scholarship Program 2027
duration: 1-2 semesters (up to 4 semesters for BA/MA scholars)
eligibility_summary: Master's and post-Master's students and researchers in all disciplines. Applicant's citizenship must differ from the host institution's country. Study or research at accredited higher-education institutions in V4 countries (Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia) or other Central/Eastern European institutions.

title: CTU Scholarship for Foreign Students of English Master's Degree Study Programmes
duration: 1-2 semesters initially, extendable to full Master's programme duration
eligibility_summary: Foreign students enrolled in Master's study programmes at CTU who display qualities entitling them to the award. Must obtain faculty agreement and submit application through International Office to the Department of International Relations at the rectorate.

title: Danish Government Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at UCPH. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

title: Danish State Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at Aarhus University. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

title: Tuition Fee Waiver
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's or PhD programme at DTU. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

title: International Student Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at AAU. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

title: University of Helsinki RESDOC Doctoral Researcher Positions 2026 (30 Fully Funded PhD Positions)
eligibility_summary: Early-stage researchers (less than 4 years of research experience) with a completed Master's degree, not yet holding a PhD. Must comply with EU MSCA mobility rule (not resident in Finland for more than 12 months in the past 3 years). Must propose a research topic fitting RESDOC themes: infectious diseases and antimicrobial resistance, biodiversity and nature's resilience, sustainable food and water systems, and just socio-ecological transition. English language proficiency required. Willingness to reside in Finland for full 4-year duration.

title: University-funded Doctoral Researcher Positions 2026 (Salaried PhD Positions)
eligibility_summary: Open to all disciplines. Must hold a master's level degree or equivalent qualifying for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki. Must not already be a PhD holder. Applications accepted in all fields of study. Positions are full-time (100% employment).

title: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship (100% Tuition Fee Waiver)
duration: Target study time (3 years Bachelor's, 2 years Master's); renewable annually pending study progress review
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students liable to pay tuition fees applying for English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes at Aalto University. Must meet admission requirements for the chosen programme. Merit-based and highly competitive - some programmes may award no scholarships. Application integrated with degree admission application via Studyinfo.fi.

title: Tampere University Scholarships (Tuition Fee Waiver + International Advancement Scholarship)
duration: Duration of the degree programme; renewable based on academic progress and study performance
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees applying to English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes. Must demonstrate high academic achievement and motivation. Scholarship application is integrated with the degree admission application via Studyinfo.fi. Document submission deadline is typically 5-7 days after application deadline.

title: University of Oulu Tuition Fee Waivers and Early Bird Discount
duration: Bachelor's: 2nd and 3rd year waivers; Master's: 2nd year waiver
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees applying to English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes at the University of Oulu. Must demonstrate academic merit. No first-year scholarships available beyond Early Bird discount. Continuing student scholarships based on completing 55 ECTS credits per year including mandatory Finnish language studies (5 ECTS).

title: University of Eastern Finland (UEF) Tuition Waivers (30% or 50%)
duration: Bachelor's: up to 3 academic years; Master's: up to 2 academic years
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees. UEF offers partial tuition waivers (30% standard or 50% for selected programmes) awarded based on application scores. No full (100%) tuition waivers available through standard application. Must apply through Studyinfo.fi. Application fee applies.

title: University of Turku Tuition Fee Waivers and Early Bird Discount
duration: Bachelor's: 2nd and 3rd year support; Master's: 2nd year merit scholarship
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees applying for English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes. No first-year tuition fee scholarships available - first-year support is only through Early Bird discount. Scholarships for continuing students awarded based on academic merit (studies completed at University of Turku). Must complete 55 ECTS credits in first year for Master's merit scholarship.

title: Åbo Akademi University Tuition Fee Scholarships (Early Commitment + Fee Waivers)
duration: 2 years (Master's); tuition waiver granted once at admission
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students liable to pay tuition fees applying to English-taught Master's programmes (and some Bachelor's programmes). For 2026 intake: Early Commitment offer available (€4,000 discount for accepting study place and paying within deadline). Prior year scholarships (for students admitted before 2026): 100% or 80% tuition fee waivers.

title: Finland Scholarship (National Programme for Master's Students)
duration: 1 year (first year tuition coverage + one-time relocation grant)
eligibility_summary: The best non-EU/EEA applicant in each Finnish Master's programme offered through the national joint application. Awarded by the Ministry of Education and Culture based on admission score ranking. No separate application required beyond the degree application via Studyinfo.fi. Applications for January 2027 intake open in September 2026.

title: Hanken School of Economics Premium Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Students from developing countries who are degree students or alumni of Global Business School Network (GBSN) member schools. Must apply to Hanken's two-year Master's Degree programme in Economics and Business Administration. Two scholarships awarded annually. Application integrated with degree application.

title: Nokia Scholarship (ICT Doctoral Studies)
eligibility_summary: Individuals pursuing a doctoral degree in Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) or in areas supporting the development of these branches of science. Applicants should have one or more accepted publications intended for inclusion in their dissertation. Optimal time to apply when applicant has strong publication record. Must have a commitment from a professor/supervisor at a Finnish university.

title: Nokia Foundation Fellow (ICT Research Project Funding)
eligibility_summary: Applications submitted by a tenured associate or full professor (Principal Investigator) at a Finnish university. The grant finances hiring a doctoral or postdoctoral researcher to work on an innovative, high-risk/high-reward ICT research project. The PI may submit one application per call. Project is led by the professor as director.

title: Jorma Ollila Grants (Recent Doctorates - International Experience)
eligibility_summary: Finnish citizens or those with permanent residence permit in Finland who have recently completed their doctorate. Must have a master's degree minimum. Intended for Finnish researchers seeking to conduct research at a high-level foreign university or research institute. The Nokia Foundation prefers advanced doctoral researchers and especially early postdocs in ICT. Finnish citizens or permanent residents only.

title: Erasmus Mundus MARIHE Scholarship (Master in Research and Innovation in Higher Education)
eligibility_summary: Open to students from all over the world with a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) completed in an EU/EEA country, Switzerland, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, UK, or US, OR a two-year Master's degree from these regions. All nationalities welcome. Students study at 7 partner institutions across Austria, China, Finland, Germany, Hungary, India, and Portugal over 2 years.

title: Erasmus Mundus EDISS Scholarship (Engineering of Data-intensive Intelligent Software Systems)
eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree in Engineering of Data-intensive Intelligent Software Systems. Students study at 4 partner universities: Åbo Akademi University (Finland), University of the Balearic Islands (Spain), University of L'Aquila (Italy), and Mälardalen University (Sweden).

title: Erasmus Mundus European Forestry (MSc EF) Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in European Forestry. Students study forest management in 7 European countries (Austria, Finland, France, Germany, Netherlands, Romania, Spain) with cohort of international students.

title: Erasmus Mundus EMCL Scholarship (European Master's in Clinical Linguistics)
eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Clinical Linguistics. Offered by University of Eastern Finland (Finland), University of Ghent (Belelgium), and University of Groningen (Netherlands). Over 20 years of running history.

title: Erasmus Mundus BioCEB Scholarship (Biochemistry and Molecular Biology)
eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Excellence in Analytical Chemistry. Finnish partner: University of Eastern Finland. Programme covers analytical chemistry in a diverse way across partner universities.

title: Fulbright-Nokia Distinguished Chair in ICT
duration: One academic year (2027-2028), with flexible start date
eligibility_summary: U.S. scholars/specialists in Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) to engage in research, collaboration, teaching, and guest lecturing at Finnish higher education institutions. The application is a dual process: separate applications to Fulbright grant competition and to University of Helsinki for admission.

title: France-South Africa Scholarship Programme 2027
duration: Master's: duration of the degree (typically 2 years); PhD: up to 3 years
eligibility_summary: South African, Lesotho or Malawian citizens admitted or applying to a French higher education institution for a Master's or PhD starting September 2027. Born on or after 1 January 1996.

title: Pasteur-Paris University (PPU) International Doctoral Program 2027
eligibility_summary: Master's degree (or equivalent) from a non-French university in science, medicine or related fields. Typically 24-26 years old. Must not have resided in France more than 12 months in the 3 years prior to the deadline. English fluency required; French not mandatory.

title: InLife Sorbonne Université International Mobility Grants 2026-2027
eligibility_summary: Master's students from foreign universities. No geographical restrictions. Interdisciplinary projects focusing on living systems. Host laboratory must be affiliated with a member institution of the Sorbonne University Alliance.

title: Sciences Po Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program 2027
eligibility_summary: Citizens of an African country (or refugee status), under 35 years of age on 1 September 2026, not already holding a Master's degree, and applying to a two-year Master's program at Sciences Po for the first time.

title: Hungarian Bilateral State Scholarships
degree: Full degree (Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral), Partial/semester studies, Postgraduate study visits, Postdoctoral study visits, Summer courses
duration: Full academic year (September - June); study visits up to 10 months
eligibility_summary: Based on bilateral educational agreements between Hungary and partner countries; applicants must be enrolled or accepted at a Hungarian higher education institution; applications via https://scholarship.hu/; scholarship paid by receiving institution or sending country

title: Momentum MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship
degree: Postdoctoral researchers (PhD holders) at MTA Lendület/Momentum research groups
funding: Employment contract with full social security
duration: Up to 36 months (minimum 12 months) with mandatory 1-3 month international secondment
eligibility_summary: Doctoral degree or successful thesis defense by deadline; MSCA mobility rule: max 12 months in Hungary in past 3 years; not employed by Lendület host at deadline; research at MTA Lendület/Momentum groups; up to ~17 full 36-month positions available

title: Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship
degree: Non-degree, Bachelor's, Master's, One-tier Master's, Doctoral, Preparatory, Foundation Year, Summer courses
duration: 12 months per year for the whole duration of scholarship period
eligibility_summary: For ethnic Hungarians and descendants living in diaspora communities outside the EU, Republic of Serbia, and Zakarpattia (Ukraine); must obtain recommendation from local Hungarian diaspora organization or diplomatic representation; application via https://apply.diasporascholarship.hu/

title: Semmelweis Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship
degree: Bachelor's, Master's, One-tier Master's (at Semmelweis University faculties)
eligibility_summary: Foreign nationals holding student status at Semmelweis University; enrolled in English or German-taught programs; began studies September 2024 or later; NOT recipients of Stipendium Hungaricum or Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship; based on academic progress and achievements in sports/arts

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Embassy Recommendation (Research Students 2027)
degree: Research Students (pathway to Master's and Ph.D.), Undergraduate, KOSEN (College of Technology), Specialized Training College, Japanese Studies, Young Leaders' Program, Teacher Training
funding: Fully funded government scholarship (tuition + stipend + airfare + insurance)
duration: 1-2 years (Research Student non-regular phase); standard period of intended Master's/Ph.D. course thereafter. Total up to 5 years. Scholarship period ends March 2029 for 2027 intake.
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan. Born on or after April 2, 1992 (under 35 at program start). Must hold or expect to hold a Bachelor's degree (for Research Student/Master's) or Master's degree (for Ph.D.) by April 2027. Undergraduate applicants must have completed 12+2 with minimum 70% marks (or equivalent). English/Japanese language proficiency may be assessed. Must be in good health. Not currently holding another Japanese government scholarship.

title: Ramanujan Fellowship (AY 2026-27)
degree: Postdoctoral/Research (Ph.D. holders in Science, Engineering, Technology, Medicine)
funding: Fully funded research fellowship (consolidated stipend + research grant + overhead)
duration: 5 years (non-extendable); must join host institute within 6 months of award letter issuance
eligibility_summary: Open to brilliant Indian/Indian-origin scientists and engineers working abroad (not holding any permanent/tenure-track/contractual position in India) who wish to return to India. Applicants must be below 40 years of age (as of date of nomination). Must possess a Ph.D./Mastery's in Engineering or Technology/MD or equivalent with adequate professional experience. Must have a proven outstanding track record of research publications and recognitions. Must work at an S&T institution in India other than the one where the Ph.D. was pursued. Currently working abroad at the time of nomination.

title: Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholarship Programme 2027
funding: Full scholarship with stipend, fees contribution, and research costs
duration: 1-4 years (2 years for research master's, 4 years for PhD; partial funding available for those in first year)
eligibility_summary: Open to new entrants to a Master's or PhD programme or registered students in the first year of the degree. Applicants must hold a first-class or upper-second-class honours bachelor's degree (or equivalent). Must be affiliated with an eligible Research Body. Open to all nationalities. Must not currently or previously hold a Research Ireland scholarship (except one that enabled a master's degree).

title: Ireland Fellows Programme 2027/2028
funding: Fully funded (fees, flights, accommodation, living costs, insurance)
eligibility_summary: Early to mid-career professionals from eligible countries (Africa, Asia, Latin America, Caribbean, Pacific, Palestine) with leadership potential. Must hold a relevant bachelor's degree, have required work experience, and not already hold a master's qualification. Must be in a position to take up the Fellowship in 2027/2028.

title: University of Galway Global Scholarships 2026/27
eligibility_summary: Non-EU countries. Merit-based awards across colleges. Specific college scholarships available for Science & Engineering, Business, Public Policy & Law, etc.

title: Hardiman Research Scholarships 2026
eligibility_summary: High-achieving individuals commencing PhD on 1 September 2026. Must not be currently registered as a PhD student or previously awarded a PhD. Must nominate one supervisor.

title: DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students 2027-28
eligibility_summary: Non-EU applicants who have received an offer to study at DCU. Automatic consideration upon application to DCU. No separate application required for most faculty scholarships. Varies by faculty: Humanities & Social Sciences, Engineering & Computing, Business, Science & Health.

title: Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme 2026
eligibility_summary: Suitably qualified postdoctoral candidates pursuing full-time research in any discipline. Must be hosted at an eligible higher education institution in Ireland.

title: Royal Society – Research Ireland University Research Fellowship 2026
eligibility_summary: Early career postdoctoral researchers with 3-8 years of research experience since PhD (career breaks considered). Must be hosted within a Research Ireland Eligible Research Body in the Republic of Ireland.

title: Sapienza University of Rome International Scholarships 2026/2027
duration: Academic year (renewable for up to 2 years)
eligibility_summary: International students applying to English-taught programmes at Sapienza University of Rome. All disciplines except Medicine and Surgery.

title: University of Padua International Excellence Scholarship
duration: Annual (up to 2-3 years depending on programme length)
eligibility_summary: International students applying to Master's or PhD programmes at the University of Padua. All degree programmes offered.

title: University of Bologna Study Grants and Fees
eligibility_summary: International students applying to degree programmes at the University of Bologna. All disciplines offered.

title: ITALYOU 4th Edition - Scholarships for Foreign Teachers of Italian Language and Culture
eligibility_summary: Foreign teachers of Italian language and culture. Must have relevant teaching experience and qualifications.

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2027 – Undergraduate Students
duration: 5 years (April 2027 – March 2032); 6 years for medicine/dentistry/veterinary medicine/pharmacy
eligibility_summary: High school seniors or recent graduates from countries with diplomatic relations with Japan. Age typically 17–25. Must indicate intended major. Requirements vary by Japanese diplomatic mission.

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2027 – Research Students
duration: 2 years or length of degree program (April 2027 – March 2028, extendable)
eligibility_summary: Graduate or postgraduate students under 35 years old with a bachelor's degree or equivalent (16 years of schooling). Open to all majors. Must explain intended field of study and benefit to Japan-home country relations.

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2026 – Japanese Studies Students
eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students at a non-Japanese university majoring in Japanese language or Japanese culture. Must have studied Japanese for at least one year. Must be able to travel to Embassy of Japan in Washington, D.C. for screening.

title: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students
degree: Undergraduate, Master's, Doctoral, Research, Junior College, College of Technology, Specialized Training College, Japanese Language Institution
eligibility_summary: Privately financed international students enrolled or planning to enroll in eligible Japanese institutions. Must have excellent academic achievement (GPA ≥ 2.30), Japanese (JLPT N2/EJU) or English (CEFR B2) proficiency, and financial need (monthly remittance < ¥90,000).

title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan – Standard Program (FY2027, 1st Round)
duration: April 1, 2027 – September 30, 2027 (commencement date flexible within period)
eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers from overseas. Must have a Japanese host researcher/institution. Application submitted by host institution through JSPS Electronic Application System.

title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan – Short-term PE (FY2027, 1st Round)
eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers from overseas with a Japanese host researcher/institution. Short-term program for collaborative research.

title: JSPS Invitational Fellowships for Research in Japan – FY2027 (1st Round, Long-term & Short-term)
duration: Long-term: April 1, 2027 – March 31, 2028; Short-term: flexible within FY2027
eligibility_summary: Overseas researchers invited by a Japanese host institution. Long-term and short-term programs available. Application submitted by host institution via JSPS Electronic Application System.

title: Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Scholarship 2027 (Overseas Candidates)
eligibility_summary: International students residing outside Japan who plan to enroll at a Japanese university or graduate school in April or September/October 2027. Must have JLPT N3 or above at time of application. Must have applied to a Japanese institution and submit admission application copy. Research students not eligible.

title: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
eligibility_summary: Non-EEA international students applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch higher education institution. Must not hold a degree from a Dutch educational institution. Must meet specific requirements of the chosen institution.
notes: Application routes through individual participating universities. List of participating universities changes annually. For 2026-2027, participating research universities include Eindhoven University of Technology, Maastricht University, Radboud University, University of Groningen, University of Twente, Utrecht University, VU Amsterdam, Wageningen University & Research, and others.

title: VU Fellowship Programme (VUFP)
funding: Merit-based tuition fee waiver + living cost contribution
eligibility_summary: Talented non-EEA/EEA students applying for a Master's programme at VU Amsterdam. Must be conditionally admitted before applying. Automatically applies for NL Scholarship when applying for VUFP.
notes: When applying for VUFP, you automatically also apply for the NL Scholarship. No separate application is necessary. Results expected mid-March 2026.

title: Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Full-time first-year Master students with excellent results from both EEA and non-EEA countries. Must have completed immigration application by May at the latest.
notes: Applications reviewed after 1 February 2026. Decisions communicated by 13 March 2026. Not applicable to current ESE Master students.

title: Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship / TSH Changemaker Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Underrepresented students pursuing a Master's programme at Erasmus MC. Must apply for one of the eligible full-time Research Master's programmes (Health Sciences, Neuroscience, or Molecular Medicine). Excellent academic standard required (average grade equivalent to Dutch 8.0/10).
notes: Limited number of scholarships available. Not all Research Master's programmes at Erasmus MC are eligible each academic year.

title: Lutfia Rabbani Scholarship Fund (LUF)
eligibility_summary: Students of Algerian, Bahraini, Egyptian, Iraqi, Jordanian, Kuwaiti, Lebanese, Libyan, Moroccan, Omani, Palestinian, Qatari, Saudi, Sudanese, Syrian, Tunisian, UAE, or Yemeni nationality. Must have official admission letter to a one-year Master's programme at Leiden University or be enrolled in second year of two-year Master's. Exceptional academic excellence and strong motivation to promote Euro-Arab dialogue required.
notes: One scholarship awarded annually. Partnership between Lutfia Rabbani Foundation and Leiden University Fund established in 2018.

title: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
eligibility_summary: Excellent non-EEA/non-EFTA students enrolling in a full-time Leiden University Master's degree programme (exceptions: Advanced LLM programmes and MSc International Relations and Diplomography, open to all nationalities). Must not be eligible for Dutch student finance. Must be among top 10% academically.
notes: Cannot combine with another full external scholarship. Award level is final and non-negotiable. UK students eligible as non-EEA country. Selection takes approximately 10 weeks; decisions before end of March 2027.

title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships
eligibility_summary: Excellent international applicants (conditionally) admitted to one of the 2-year regular TU Delft MSc programmes (not International Joint Education Programmes). Must have bachelor's degree from outside Netherlands. Must be among top 10% of graduates. Must submit complete MSc application before scholarship deadline.
notes: All documents (MSc application, Scholarship Application Form, 2 reference letters, English language certificate) must be submitted together before deadline. No additional documents accepted after submission. Results by end of March 2027.

title: Wageningen University Excellence Programme
eligibility_summary: International MSc students from non-EU and non-EFTA countries starting an MSc programme in September 2027 with unconditional admission. High GPA of 80% or higher required. First Class honours BSc graduation or equivalent.
notes: Invitation-based selection. Around March-April 2027, selected applicants informed of final stage. Lottery determines recipients among final-stage candidates. Offers scheduled for 7 April 2027. Only for September start; not available for February start.

title: NWO Embassy Science Fellowship (ESF-NL) 2027
duration: 1-3 months (can be intermittent, start period 1 March 2027 - 29 February 2028)
eligibility_summary: PhD graduates from Dutch research organisations (universities, universities of applied sciences, KNAW institutes, NWO institutes, Netherlands Cancer Institute, Max Planck Institute for Psycholinguistics, Naturalis, ARCNL, Princess Máxima Center, IHE Delft, TO2 institutions). Researchers with fixed PhD date also eligible if PhD obtained at fellowship start.
notes: Informative webinar on 2 July 2026. Assessment committee meeting October 2026. Decision by NWO Executive Board November 2026. 12 positions available.

title: Thijssen-Schoute Fellowship 2027
eligibility_summary: PhD students at an advanced stage or recent PhD graduates (PhD defence no more than 3 years ago). Research in history of ideas, with special focus on 17th century and Dutch Republic.
notes: Research to take place at Huygens Institute's Knowledge and Art Practices research group in Amsterdam. Must submit research plan (max 1,000 words), CV, and two references.

title: KB Fellowship at NIAS 2026-2027
eligibility_summary: Scholarly researchers with at least 3 years of research experience after PhD (on closing date) or creative practitioners with at least 3 years of independent art practice since formal graduation. Open to researchers with or without institutional affiliation.
notes: One five-month fellowship per year. Call open from 15 January to 16 March 2026. Application includes research proposal (max 1,500 words), academic/artistic CV, and motivation (max 300 words).

title: Willem F. Duisenberg Fellowship 2027-2028
eligibility_summary: Prominent, leading mid-to-late-career researchers or promising early-career talents from Netherlands or abroad. Minimum three years of post-PhD academic experience. Research in applied monetary economics, macroeconomics, or public finance.
notes: Call for 2027-2028 academic year open from 15 January to 13 April 2026. Encourages reflection on collaborative and multidisciplinary environment at NIAS.

title: Eric Bleumink Fellowship
eligibility_summary: Students from developing countries (Afghanistan, Angola, Bangladesh, Benin, Bhutan, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cambodia, Chad, Comoros, Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Haiti, Kiribati, Lesotho, Liberia, Madagascar, Malawi, Mali, Mauritania, Mozambique, Myanmar, Nepal, Rwanda, Sao Tome and Principe, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Solomon Islands, Somalia, Tanzania, Togo, Tuvalu, Uganda, Vanuatu, Yemen, Timor-Leste, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Zambia, Bolivia, Cape Verde, Congo, Ghana, Honduras, India, Korea Dem. Rep., Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Morocco, Nigeria, Vietnam, Uzbekistan, Ukraine, Algeria, Cameroon, Egypt, Iran, Ivory Coast, Jordan, Kenya, Micronesia, Nicaragua, Niger, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, Samoa, Sri Lanka, Sudan, Tajikistan, Tokelau, Tunisia, Zimbabwe, Lao PDR). Must have provisional or unconditional admission offer before February.
notes: University of Groningen Admission Office determines nominations in consultation with Admission Boards. Only applicants with provisional or unconditional admission offer before February can be considered. Master application should be completed by 1 December to allow processing time.

title: KITLV Visiting Fellowships 2026 (2nd call)
eligibility_summary: Scholars with a PhD in Social Sciences and/or Humanities carrying out research in Southeast Asian and/or Caribbean Studies. Not required to have university or research institute affiliation, but must have steady income during fellowship. Must not be a tax resident of the Netherlands.
notes: Fellows work on publication or research project of own choice. Submit proposal in English. Applications via 'Apply Now' button on website.

title: Tilburg University Waiver
eligibility_summary: Non-EEA international applicants who completed their most recent degree in one of the eligible countries (Afghanistan, Albania, Armenia, Bangladesh, Belarus, Bolivia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, China, Colombia, Congo DR, Côte d'Ivoire, Ecuador, Egypt, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Georgia, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Iran, Iraq, Jordan, Kenya, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Liberia, Mauritania, Mexico, Moldova, Morocco, Myanmar, Namibia, Nepal, Nigeria, North Macedonia, Pakistan, Palestine, Peru, Philippines, Serbia, Sierra Leone, Sri Lanka, Sudan, Syria, Taiwan, Tanzania, Tunisia, Türkiye, Uganda, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Venezuela, Vietnam, Yemen). Must be first Master's at Tilburg.
notes: Must submit complete Master's programme application and Tilburg University Waiver application form by 1 April 2026. If fewer than 21 waivers accepted, remaining awards assigned by lottery to non-EEA applicants with conditional/unconditional admission by 1 June 2026.

title: Radboud Scholarship Programme
eligibility_summary: Highly talented non-EEA students applying for a full-time Master's programme at Radboud University. Must meet English language requirements and have excellent academic background.
notes: Application deadline is 1 February 2026 for September 2026 intake. Decisions communicated by end of March 2026. Cannot be combined with other full scholarships.

title: Orange Knowledge Programme (OKP) 2026
eligibility_summary: Professionals from eligible countries in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. Must have at least 2 years of relevant work experience. Must meet admission requirements of Dutch higher education institution. Not available for students from EU/EEA countries.
notes: Application through Dutch diplomatic missions in home country. List of eligible countries changes periodically. Check official website for country-specific deadlines and requirements.

title: Erasmus University Rotterdam Scholarships
eligibility_summary: International students applying for Master's programmes at Erasmus University Rotterdam. Multiple scholarships available with different criteria and eligibility requirements.
notes: Check individual programme pages for specific scholarships and deadlines. Includes Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship, TSH Changemaker Scholarship, and others.

title: University of Amsterdam Scholarships
eligibility_summary: International students applying for Bachelor's or Master's programmes at UvA. Multiple scholarships available with different criteria.
notes: Check UvA website for specific scholarships including Amsterdam Merit Scholarship, UvA Talent Grant, and others.

title: Tulī Takes Flight Scholarships 2026
degree: Vocational, Undergraduate, Graduate, Postgraduate up to Doctoral
eligibility_summary: Pacific peoples seeking to reduce financial barriers towards study or training in Aotearoa New Zealand. Open for vocational or degree-level study.

title: New Zealand Space Scholarship 2026
duration: 3 months (NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory internship, June–September 2026)
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens enrolled in a postgraduate degree in science, technology, engineering or mathematics at a New Zealand tertiary institution in 2026, with an interest in space and advanced aviation.

title: Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships 2026 — Mana Tūāpapa Future Leader Fellowship
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents with a PhD conferred within 4 years of the closing date (on or after 9 July 2022), supported by a New Zealand-based research organisation. Must not have previously been awarded a major research grant as Principal Investigator.

title: Rhodes Scholarship for New Zealand 2026
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents who have spent at least 5 of the previous 10 years in NZ. Must be 18–24 on 1 October 2026 (or up to 27 if first undergraduate degree completed after 1 October 2025). Academic excellence required.

title: Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarships 2026–2027
duration: Up to 3 years (undergraduate); up to 2 years (master's); up to 2 years (doctoral)
eligibility_summary: Māori students pursuing vocational or tertiary study at university, wānanga, or in vocational education and training. Values aligned with the 28th Māori Battalion.

title: Kupe Scholarship for Māori and Pacific High Achievers 2027
degree: Undergraduate, Graduate Diploma in Teaching, Master of Teaching
eligibility_summary: Māori or Pacific descent, New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or resident visa holder. Must have completed at least one full year of an approved teaching course or be enrolled in an approved Graduate Diploma/Master of Teaching with academic excellence (B+ average or above for undergraduates).

title: University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship 2027
eligibility_summary: School leavers planning to start undergraduate study at the University of Auckland in 2027. Academic achievement and potential.

title: University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship 2027
eligibility_summary: Pacific students commencing first-year undergraduate study at the University of Auckland in 2027.

title: University of Waikato Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship 2026
eligibility_summary: International students (excluding those eligible for specific regional scholarships) with an Offer of Place from the University of Waikato. Academic merit and potential to become global ambassadors.

title: University of Otago Vice-Chancellor's International Postgraduate Scholarships
eligibility_summary: International students commencing selected full-time postgraduate programmes at the University of Otago. Not citizens, permanent residents or resident visa holders of New Zealand or Australia. Minimum NZ B+ equivalent.

title: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
eligibility_summary: International students obtaining their first Master's qualification and undertaking a thesis-based Master's at the University of Otago. Academic merit and research potential.

title: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Domestic and international students

title: Ignacy Łukasiewicz Scholarship
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
duration: 1 or 2 semesters (extendable to full academic year)
eligibility: Foreign students from outside the EU holding a Card of the Pole / Polish descent or from partner countries; must have completed Bachelor-level studies; field of study not offered in home country or limited spots; Polish language course attendance may be required
notes: Annual competition; applications submitted online via NAWA system. Named after Polish Nobel Peace Prize nominee and oil pioneer

title: Stefan Banach Scholarship
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
duration: Full academic year (10 months) or full degree programme duration
eligibility: International students (both EU and non-EU) from developing countries and partner countries; must hold a university entrance qualification recognised in Poland; aged under 30 (may be relaxed for PhD); field of study aligned with Polish higher education offer
notes: Named after famous Polish mathematician Stefan Banach. Administered through Polish embassies/consulates in partner countries and via university coordinators. Detailed page: https://study.gov.pl/stefan-banach-nawa-programme

title: Konstanty Kalinowski Scholarship
degree: Bachelor, Master, Engineer, Long-cycle Master, Doctoral, Postgraduate
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
duration: 1 semester to entire study programme (1–3 years depending on degree)
eligibility: Students and graduates from Eastern Partnership countries (Georgia, Ukraine, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Moldova); must hold secondary school diploma or higher education qualification; max age 26 (may be relaxed)
notes: Named after Polish-Lithuanian political activist. Focus on Eastern Partnership region. Applications via NAWA online system

title: General Władysław Anders Scholarship
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
eligibility: Students and graduates from Ukraine; must have secondary school diploma or higher education; aged under 26 (may be relaxed for PhD)
notes: Named after Polish WWII general of the II Corps. Priority for Ukrainian nationals. Part of Poland's support for Ukrainian students during and post-conflict

title: NAWA Ulam Programme (International Research Projects)
eligibility: International researchers (non-Polish citizens) conducting joint research projects with Polish research teams; PhD students, postdocs, and professors; host institution must be a Polish higher education or research organisation
notes: Competition announced annually around April; online application via NAWA portal. Named after Polish Nobel laureate in Physics

title: NAWA TOP200 Programme (Excellence Initiative)
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel allowance
eligibility: Exceptional non-EU students enrolling in TOP200-ranked Master's programmes at participating Polish universities; must meet admission requirements and demonstrate academic excellence (ranked top of cohort)
notes: Targets the best 200 international students annually. Participating universities determined by Excellence Initiative ranking

title: NAWA Bekker Programme (Academic Exchange)
degree: Bachelor, Master, PhD, Postdoctoral researcher, Professor
eligibility: Academic exchange for short-term research/teaching stays at Polish universities and research institutes; open to researchers at all career stages
notes: Named after Polish mathematician Stanisław Błażej (Anglicised as Bekker). Shorter-duration alternative to Ulam programme

title: NAWA Walczak Programme (Internships)
eligibility: PhD students (non-Polish) undertaking research internships at Polish universities or research institutes participating in the programme
notes: Named after Polish chemist and Nobel laureate Stanisław Walczak. Single annual round with February deadline

title: Visegrad Scholarship Programme
eligibility: Students from V4 countries (Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary) and from Eastern Partnership countries, Western Balkans, and other partner states; must be enrolled in a higher education institution in home country
notes: Also open to students from Georgia, Ukraine, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Moldova, and Western Balkan countries. Applications via Visegrad Fund online system

title: Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel + Insurance
duration: Full study programme (up to 2 years) or up to 10 months for postgraduate
eligibility: Students and graduates from Ukraine, Belarus, and other partner countries (Eastern Partnership region); focus on those who wish to study or conduct research in Poland to build professional ties
notes: Named after American politician and diplomat Lane Kirkland. Applications twice a year. Detailed page: https://study.gov.pl/lane-kirkland-scholarship-program

title: Poland My First Choice (PMFC)
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel + Insurance
eligibility: High school graduates (non-Polish citizens, non-EU); must have scored minimum 80% in national secondary school exam; apply for full Bachelor's degree studies in STEM/IT fields; limited programme slots per university
notes: Aimed at attracting top high school graduates to Poland for their entire Bachelor's degree. Single annual round. Applications via university recruitment systems coordinated by NAWA

title: UNESCO/Poland Co-Sponsored Fellowships Programme in Engineering
eligibility: Students enrolled in BSc or MSc engineering programmes from developing countries (UNESCO invited Member States list of 71 countries); medical certificate required; proficiency in English or Polish
notes: 30 fellowship slots annually. Hosted at AGH University of Science and Technology in Krakow. Application via National Commission for UNESCO + Fellowship e-registration system. Detailed URL: https://unesco.agh.edu.pl/en/

title: Erasmus+ Programme
degree: Bachelor, Master, PhD, Postdoctoral, Vocational training
eligibility: EU and partner country students enrolled in higher education institutions participating in Erasmus+; study or traineeship period in Poland
notes: Polish National Agency for Erasmus+ programme: https://erasmusplus.org.pl/. Not Poland-specific but Poland is a major host country

title: Fulbright Program (Poland-US)
degree: Graduate, PhD, Postdoctoral, Teaching, Research, Professional
duration: Academic year (9–10 months); flexible for shorter terms
eligibility: Highly qualified US citizens for study/research/teaching in Poland; highly qualified Polish citizens for study/research/teaching in the US; all degree levels and fields
notes: One of the most prestigious exchange programs. Administered jointly since 1959. Separate application processes for US and Polish citizens. Detailed US-citizen info: https://fulbright.edu.pl/en/category/grants/for-american-citizens/ and https://eca.state.gov/fulbright/country/poland

title: CEEPUS Exchange Programme
funding: Tuition waiver + Monthly stipend (subsidized by host country)
eligibility: Students and staff from CEEPUS member countries (16 Central and Eastern European countries; non-CEEPUS citizens may apply for remaining slots); enrolled at home institution
notes: Member countries include Poland, Czech Rep., Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania, Bulgaria, Romania, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia. Network-based coordination

title: Polish Government Scholarships (Bilateral Agreements)
degree: Bachelor, Master, Engineer, Long-cycle Master, Doctoral, Postgraduate
duration: Full study programme (1–3 years depending on degree)
eligibility: Students and graduates from partner countries with existing bilateral agreements with Poland; must meet university admission criteria; field of study must be available at partner Polish university
notes: Administered through Polish embassies and consulates worldwide. Applications submitted through diplomatic missions. Deadlines and funding levels vary by country. Contact BUWiWM for details: http://www.buwiwm.edu.pl

title: Solidarity with Belarus Scholarship Initiative
duration: Full study programme or academic semester
eligibility: Students from Belarus; particularly supporting those affected by political events; must hold higher education qualification or be currently enrolled
notes: Ongoing humanitarian initiative launched in response to situation in Belarus. Applications via NAWA system. Limited slots per university

title: SAF Merit Scholarship
