eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or permanent residents intending to take up citizenship. Good GCE 'A' Level or IB results, Polytechnic Diploma (with Merit). Strong leadership qualities, good CCA records. Must qualify for and excel in Officer Cadet School.

title: MHA Civilian Scholarship
eligibility_summary: All-rounded individuals passionate about strengthening Singapore's safety and security. Singapore citizens. Can choose from Generalist or Specialist roles (Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security, Psychology).

title: Singapore Police Force Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Outstanding leadership qualities, impeccable integrity, strong interest in policing work. Singapore citizens. Open to male and female applicants.

title: PSC Undergraduate Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Strong leadership qualities and potential. Well-rounded individuals with good academic and non-academic records. Pre-university or mid-term applicants (up to penultimate year).

title: PSC Master's Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Final year undergraduate students or fresh graduates with no more than 3 years working experience. Must start Master's in immediate academic year following offer.

title: Lee Kuan Yew Scholarship
duration: Up to 2 years (Master's) or up to 5 years (PhD)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens only. Track record of leadership and achievement. Potential to excel in chosen field. No course restrictions.

title: MOE Teaching Scholarship (Full-Term)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or PRs willing to take up citizenship. Strong passion for education service, leadership qualities. Various qualification-specific windows.

title: Singapore-Industry Scholarship (SgIS)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Good GCE A-Level, Polytechnic Diploma, IB Diploma or NUS High School Diploma. Good CCA records and leadership achievements. Passion to contribute to Singapore's strategic sectors. Three schemes: Full-Term, Mid-Term (Local), Mid-Term (Overseas).

title: SINGA - Singapore International Graduate Award
eligibility_summary: International graduates (all nationalities except Singapore citizens and PRs). Excellent academic results, strong research portfolio, proficiency in English.

title: A*STAR International Fellowship (AIF)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or Singapore PRs. Completed PhD within last 4 years. No existing institutional bonds. Must have secured postdoctoral position at leading overseas institution. Two tracks: Research and Innovation.

title: National Science Scholarship (PhD)
duration: Up to 4 years (PhD); up to 8 years (BS-PhD)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or other nationals intending to take up Singapore citizenship. Good class of Honours degree. Must have applied for PhD at top overseas institution. 1-year research attachment at A*STAR required before PhD.

title: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship (AGS)
eligibility_summary: Currently enrolled in Singapore autonomous university. Completed at least 1 semester. On track to excellent academic standing. Non-Singaporeans must have SPR or citizenship. Four tracks: STEM, Semiconductor, Quantum, Computing.

title: NUS Undergraduate Scholarship (incl. Global Merit, Merit, AI Talent, Sports, Performing & Visual Arts)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Strong leadership qualities, good CCA records, outstanding academic results (GCE A-Level, Polytechnic Diploma, IB, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent).

title: Nanyang Merit Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Outstanding freshmen with strong academic results, good CCA records, good leadership qualities. Full-time undergraduate programme at NTU.

title: NTU President Award
eligibility_summary: Students with exceptional leadership qualities, excellent co-curricular records, outstanding academic performance.

title: SMU Global Impact Scholarship Award
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding academic results, strong leadership capabilities, excellent co-curricular/community activities. Applying for full-time undergraduate degree at SMU.

title: SMU Merit Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Academic excellence, outstanding leadership qualities, commitment to community.

title: Temasek Undergraduate Overseas Scholarship
duration: Duration of undergraduate studies (capped at 4 years) + 3-year bond
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Local polytechnic graduates or graduating polytechnic students. Accepted or planning to enroll in STEM undergraduate course at overseas university (excluding Medicine and Dentistry). Gross Monthly Household Income <= S$15,000.

title: Temasek Undergraduate Local Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Polytechnic graduates enrolling in STEM programmes at Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT).

title: SUTD Undergraduate Merit Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding GCE 'A' Level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or equivalent. Passion for technology and design.

title: SUTD Trailblazers Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding academic results, strong leadership capabilities, excellent co-curricular/community activities, desire to make impact on society.

title: SUSS Scholarship (Part-time Undergraduate)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or permanent residents. Outstanding academic results, strong language skills, impressive CCA track record, leadership qualities, community service involvement.

title: SUSS Research Scholarship
duration: Up to 4 years (PhD); up to 2 years (Master's)
eligibility_summary: Applicants seeking admission to PhD or Master of Applied Research in Social Sciences. At least 2nd Upper Class Honours Degree. Research aligned with SUSS focus areas.

title: NTU Short Term Scholarships
eligibility_summary: Current undergraduates or freshmen on subsidised tuition fees who have performed well academically and meet donor criteria.

title: Swedish Institute Scholarship Pioneering Women in STEM
eligibility_summary: Female citizens from 10 countries in Africa and Asia: Bangladesh, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Philippines, Rwanda, South Africa, Thailand, Vietnam. Must be admitted to an eligible master's programme in STEM fields at a Swedish university.

title: KTH Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Fee-paying international students (non-EU/EEA/Swiss) who have applied for a master's programme at KTH as their first priority via universityadmissions.se and paid the application fee. Must demonstrate academic excellence and drive to contribute to sustainable development.

title: KI Global Master's Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Tuition fee-paying students who have applied for a master's programme at Karolinska Institutet and ranked a KI programme as their first choice. Approximately 10-12 scholarships awarded annually from ~700-1000 applicants.

title: Lund University Global Scholarship
duration: Duration of the degree programme (up to 2 years for Master's)
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied for a degree programme at Lund University as first choice via universityadmissions.se and paid the application fee. Merit-based; financial need not considered.

title: Uppsala University Global Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must demonstrate academic talent and have applied for a Master's programme at Uppsala University as first priority via universityadmissions.se. Highly competitive (~2% success rate).

title: Stockholm University Scholarship Scheme
eligibility_summary: Citizens from countries outside EU/EEA/Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must be admitted to a Master's programme at Stockholm University in the first (international) admission round. Priority given to students with Stockholm University as first choice on universityadmissions.se.

title: Malmö University Master's Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Students from outside EU/EEA and Switzerland who have applied for an English-taught master's programme at Malmö University as first choice, been admitted, and are required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied in the first admissions round and paid the application fee.

title: Lund University African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA) Scholarship
duration: Duration of the master's programme (up to 2 years)
eligibility_summary: Students who have been enrolled at an ARUA member university in Africa (including University of Cape Town, University of Ghana, University of Nairobi, University of Lagos, etc.) and are citizens of a country outside the EU/EEA required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied to Lund University as first choice via universityadmissions.se.

title: KTH One-Year Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Current KTH master's programme students who are fee-paying and perform strongly during their first year. Not available for joint or EIT master's programmes.

title: KTH India Scholarship
funding: Full tuition waiver + monthly living allowance
eligibility_summary: Indian applicants admitted to a master's programme at KTH. Applicants from Mumbai and Pune receive priority under the foundation rules, but the scholarship remains open to eligible Indian applicants from other regions. Very competitive (one award offered in 2026).

title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
duration: Regular duration of the Master's programme (3 or 4 semesters). Tuition fee waiver covers the same period.
eligibility_summary: Outstanding Master's applicants (no MAS). Must have very good Bachelor's results (top 10% = grade A, self-assessed). Not already enrolled in a Master's at ETH Zurich or holding a Master's degree. Must apply within the first application window.

title: EPFL Bachelor Excellence Fellowships
eligibility_summary: Holders of a Swiss high-school maturity diploma or Swiss vocational maturity diploma undertaking the CMS. Outstanding results and engagement in school and extracurricular activities.

title: SNF Postdoc.Mobility
duration: 24 months (fellowship) + 3 to 12 months (return phase). Mobility fellowship must start no later than 12 months after ruling.
eligibility_summary: Researchers who have completed a doctorate (PhD, MD-PhD) or medical studies. Submission up to 3 years after doctoral exam (PhD); up to 8 years after state examination for medical researchers. Swiss citizenship/permit or degree from Swiss institution required (no prior postdoctoral position abroad for non-Swiss).

title: SNF Ambizione
duration: Maximum 4 years. Earliest project start: 1 September 2027; latest: 1 September 2028.
eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers with a PhD (or medical studies) who wish to conduct, manage and lead an independent project at a Swiss higher education institution. Max 4 years after completing PhD. Must have Swiss nationality, hold a Swiss degree, or have carried out research in Switzerland for at least 12 months after doctorate.

title: SNF Starting Grants
funding: Grant (salary + project funds up to CHF 1M)
duration: 5 years. Earliest project start: 1 May 2027; latest: 1 May 2028.
eligibility_summary: Researchers with a doctorate and several years of research experience (2–8 years after PhD). Must not yet have achieved the objective of leading their own research project and team. Must have a Swiss link (Swiss nationality, Swiss degree, or at least 2 years research in Switzerland at 80% FTE).

title: UZH Student Financial Aid Office – Scholarships
duration: Per semester or academic year, depending on financial need and progress.
eligibility_summary: First-degree programmes only. International Bachelor's students: eligible after earning 55 ECTS credits. International Master's students: eligible only if they hold a Swiss Bachelor's degree. Parents' taxable income must not exceed CHF 86,000 (net worth under CHF 300,000). All other financing sources must be exhausted.

title: EPFL Social Scholarship
duration: 5 or 10 months per academic year (1 or 2 semesters).
eligibility_summary: EPFL students in difficult financial situations. Swiss/C-permit/refugee students: from 1st year propaedeutic (or CMS in exceptional cases). International students: after completing at least one year at EPFL and successful completion of first-year cycle. Last resort after cantonal scholarships and other funding sources are exhausted.

title: Hans Wilsdorf Foundation Scholarship (EPFL)
duration: Per academic year (1 or 2 semesters), maximum 10 months per year of study.
eligibility_summary: International students: after successful completion of first year and at least one year at EPFL, residing in Canton of Geneva. Swiss/C-permit/refugee/Swiss secondary certificate: from CMS, residing in Canton of Geneva or applied for cantonal scholarship (SBPE). Managed under same criteria as EPFL social scholarships.

title: UZH Hardship Loan
eligibility_summary: Enrolled at UZH in acute financial emergency without any debt. Must plausibly guarantee repayment within six months. Short-term bridge for financial gaps (e.g., waiting for cantonal scholarship).

title: MOE Huayu Enrichment Scholarship (HES)
duration: 2 months (summer), 3 months, 6 months, 9 months, or 12 months
eligibility_summary: Foreign persons at least 18 years old, graduated from secondary school or post-secondary level, excellent academic record, good moral character. Not open to ROC passport holders or those currently studying Chinese in Taiwan.

title: MOE Short Term Research Award (STRA)
eligibility_summary: International scholars (excluding mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao) who are PhD students at overseas approved universities or postdoctoral fellows. Must not hold ROC passport, not currently in Taiwan, not receiving other Taiwan government financial assistance, and not have received STRA within last 5 years.

title: NYCU International Student Scholarship
duration: Generally 1 year per award; maximum 4 years (undergraduate), 2 years (master), 5 years (PhD)
eligibility_summary: Current NYCU international students who have not received Taiwan government scholarships. Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 for graduate students and 3.0 for undergraduate students. Not eligible if currently receiving government-funded scholarships or holding working VISA/ARC.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program 2027-2028
eligibility_summary: Citizens of participating countries (160+). Applicants apply through their home-country U.S. Embassy or Fulbright Commission. Must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent. For master's/doctoral study or research in the U.S. English proficiency required.

title: Fulbright U.S. Student Program 2027-2028
degree: Master's, Doctorate, Non-degree research/study, Creative arts
duration: Typically 9-12 months; grants must begin no later than June 1, 2028 for 2027-2028 cycle
eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens or permanent residents enrolled in or applying to U.S. undergraduate or graduate programs. Apply through campus Fulbright Program Adviser. Must not have extensive prior U.S. experience for certain awards.

title: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program 2027-2028
official_source: U.S. Department of State (Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs)
eligibility_summary: Mid-career professionals from eligible countries. Bachelor's degree required. Minimum 5 years full-time professional experience. Demonstrated leadership and public service commitment. Limited prior U.S. experience. English proficiency.

title: East-West Center Graduate Degree Fellowship 2027
duration: Up to 24 months; granted one year at a time and renewable
eligibility_summary: Citizens or permanent residents of the United States, or citizens of Asia-Pacific countries. Admission to University of Hawai'i at Manoa graduate program required by December 1. Priority given to applicants with commitment to Asia-Pacific region.

title: AAUW International Fellowships 2026-2027
eligibility_summary: Women who are NOT U.S. citizens or permanent residents. Full-time study in STEM fields at accredited U.S. institution. Minimum GPA 3.5 on a 4.0 scale. Must begin program on or before September 15, 2027 and complete on or after April 30, 2028. TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 / Cambridge 176 / Duolingo DET 120.

title: Rotary Peace Fellowship 2027-2028
duration: 1-2 years depending on program (certificate or master's)
eligibility_summary: Experienced peacebuilders from any country. Strong commitment to peace and conflict resolution. Proficiency in language of instruction at host university. Competitive selection by Rotary Foundation. Up to 170 fellows selected annually.

title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) 2026
eligibility_summary: Citizens of eligible developing countries or Japanese nationals. Must be admitted to or enrolled in a participating master's or PhD program in a development-related field outside home country. Minimum 3 years full-time paid development-related employment since bachelor's degree. Bachelor's degree earned at least 3 years before application deadline.

title: Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship (Fall 2026 Cycle)
eligibility_summary: U.S. undergraduate students who have received a Federal Pell Grant. Studying or interning abroad on credit-bearing program starting between December 1, 2026 and October 31, 2027. Critical language study eligible for additional $3,000; STEM research eligible for additional $1,000.

title: Boren Awards 2027-2028 (Scholarships and Fellowships)
eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens. Undergraduates or graduate students in any field. Commitment to national security and language/cultural study abroad. Preference for study of less commonly taught languages and critical regions. Must study abroad for at least one semester.

title: Phi Kappa Phi Fellowship 2026
eligibility_summary: Active Phi Kappa Phi members (dues paid) or accepted members initiated by June 30, 2026. Seeking full-time enrollment in graduate/professional school beginning between May 1, 2026 and February 1, 2027. Not more than 9 graduate semester credits completed at application deadline. International students and accredited international institutions eligible.

title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens, nationals, or permanent residents. Graduate students in STEM fields or those pursuing research-based master's or doctoral degrees at accredited U.S. institutions. No more than 2 years of graduate study completed at application deadline.

title: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid 2027-2028
eligibility_summary: All applicants regardless of citizenship. Need-blind admissions for all applicants including international. International students eligible for same aid as U.S. students. CSS Profile and IDOC required. FAFSA required for U.S. citizens/permanent residents.

title: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid 2027-2028
duration: 4 years (renewable; international students do not need to reapply annually)
eligibility_summary: All applicants regardless of citizenship. Need-blind admissions. International students must indicate financial aid interest on admission application. CSS Profile not required for admissions/financial aid unless requested by office.

title: MIT Undergraduate Financial Aid for International Students 2026-2027
eligibility_summary: All applicants including international students. Need-blind, need-based, full-need for all students regardless of citizenship. International students follow same process as domestic. CSS Profile and IDOC required.

title: UT Austin International Student Scholarships (Spring 2027 and Fall 2027)
duration: Varies by scholarship (term or academic year)
eligibility_summary: International students meeting eligibility criteria for specific scholarships. Apply via LASSO university-wide scholarship system using keyword 'ISSS'. Must be admitted or enrolled at UT Austin.

title: University of Chicago International Scholarships for Undergraduates
eligibility_summary: International students applying for undergraduate admission. Need-blind admissions for international students. CSS Profile and IDOC required. Demonstrates full financial need for all admitted students.

title: Carnegie Mellon University Africa Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
eligibility_summary: Young African citizens committed to using technical education to benefit their communities. Demonstrated financial need. Strong academic performance. Bachelor's degree or final year student. Programs: MSIT, MSECE, MSEAI.

title: Google PhD Fellowship Program 2027 (anticipated)
eligibility_summary: Full-time PhD students in eligible research areas (AI/ML, systems, security, quantum, HCI, etc.). Must be nominated by eligible university; direct student applications not accepted. Available across multiple regions worldwide.

title: Trinity University International Academic Scholarships and Financial Aid
eligibility_summary: International undergraduate applicants. Automatically awarded at time of admission. No separate scholarship application. No undergraduate application fee. Apply through Common Application.

title: JWU Global Full Tuition Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Non-U.S. citizen incoming undergraduate full-time students. Must be invited to apply through JWU Admissions Portal after completing undergraduate application by Early Action 2 deadline (January 4, 2026). Demonstrated leadership through extracurricular, volunteer, or entrepreneurial activities. Must submit Global Impact Statement and two letters of recommendation.
